use_when: A useful outcome genuinely requires ordered actions.
The reader can begin without hidden prerequisites.
The sequence has a real quality check or decision point.

recombination.reverse_build_specification: When an opportunity needs a repeatable start-to-finish path, use numbered stages with one action and one visible output per stage. Make progress feel possible, include the point at which the reader must judge or validate, and reserve the caption for context and exceptions.

Correct logic, process or sourced evidence proportionate to the selected claim.
An original visual object/scene/interface that proves the chosen promise.
A caption that adds a different layer of value from the visual.
